name: Agent Browser MCP Server
description: A browser automation MCP server hosted on Vercel that enables AI agents to perform web interactions like clicking, typing, and capturing screenshots via Browserless.io. It supports persistent session management and Basic authentication for seamless navigation across protected sites.
